items.title: Workers reeling after VW cuts open door to factory closures
items.summary: The day after Volkswagen management, shareholders and unions agreed to cut a total 100,000 jobs over the coming years, automotive workers told AFP Friday they were feeling a mix of fury and disappointment.Management and unions agreed Thursday only to seek "alternative uses" for the plants.

items.title: The Lowe’s Foundation wants to train 1 million craft workers
items.summary: The tool and DIY retailer’s foundation has partnered with NVIDIA, General Motors and other U.S. business behemoths to help bolster the construction labor force by 2035.

items.title: Lowe’s Foundation launches skilled trades coalition to train 1M workers by 2035
items.summary: The move comes amid a significant skilled trades labor shortage in the U.S.

items.title: BMW Stock Has Rarely Been Cheaper Amid Pressure in Chinese Market
items.summary: The German car maker has an impeccable balance sheet and a great new electric-vehicle platform. Its profit margins should rebound.

items.title: Nvidia Is Now Paying to Train Plumbers, and the Stock That Should Benefit Most Just Hit a 52-Week Low
items.summary: Nvidia just committed serious money to train plumbers and electricians, and the retailer that sells to those exact tradespeople responded by printing a 52-week low. Something in that equation does not add up.

items.title: General Motors (GM) Rises Higher Than Market: Key Facts
items.summary: General Motors (GM) closed at $87.22 in the latest trading session, marking a +2.77% move from the prior day.

items.title: Should You Pay A Growth Price For Tesla's Thin Profits?
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) trades at about $357, and most of the argument around it is about what the company will build next. A plainer number gets less attention, and it is how much of each sales dollar the company keeps. Its operating margin over the past twelve months was 4.6%. That is the figure a holder should weigh before anything else.

items.title: Is Ford Stock Worth Buying Now As F-Series Production Rebounds?
items.summary: Ford's F-Series production is rebounding, but weak U.S. sales, plunging EV demand and rising costs keep the stock outlook balanced.
